subject.name: Security and Fire Alarm Systems Installers
subject.summary: Security and fire alarm systems installers (O*NET 49-2098) install, program, maintain and repair alarm equipment per work orders and drawings, test circuits, sensors, backup batteries and alarm functions, and explain use and false alarm handling to clients. Construction, fire and electrical requirements follow local codes and authorization.
